Keep Maryland Beautiful Grant Program

Main_Content


​The Maryland Environmental Trust in partnership with the Maryland Department of Transportation​, Maryland Department of Agriculture​​ ​as well as the Chesapeake Bay Trust​ presents the Keep Maryland Beautiful Grant Program. Grants through the Keep Maryland Beautiful program help volunteer-based, nonprofit groups, communities and land trusts in Maryland to support environmental education projects, litter removal, citizen stewardship and to protect natural resources in urban and rural areas.

Combined, this partnership has provided more than a million dollars over the past three decades to nonprofits, schools, land trusts and volunteer-based programs that work to protect natural resources while enhancing the lives of Maryland citizens and generations to come.

​
​

Application period opens on September 3, 2026.

The ​​Community Stewardship
These grants are available to nonprofits, schools and municipalities.

Land Trust Assistance​​
These grants are available to Maryland local land trusts.

Tree Planting on Agricultural Lands
Projects on individual private, commercial private, community-owned, nonprofit, and government ​owned property are eligible for funding.​​​

Grant Application Details​

​​ ​

Important Dates and Details

​
  • Begin Application Process
  • Applications must be submitted online (Opens September 3). ​
  • The Application deadline is December 1, 2026.
  • Funds ​are to be used from March 30, 2027 -February 28, 2028.
  • Award winners will be announced on March 20, Keep Maryland Beautiful Day.
  • Grant money will be received by April 15, 2027.
  • Grant Receipt Forms must be signed and returned within one month of receiving grant money.
  • Final Grant reports are due within two months of the culmination of the project or by March 2, 2028.​

​

​​The Chesapeake Bay Trust will be administering the "Keep Maryland Beautiful" Grants for the Maryland Environmental Trust.

​​For additional information send emails to Marylin Veiman-Echeverria​ (​ [email protected]). Be sure to put the name of your organization in the subject line.
